demonstrates: Generalised a single-subject risk-prediction service into a pluggable-domain architecture and then added two domains behind one protocol, with the two shared training and explanation libraries untouched by either addition and the plug-in seam itself corrected by the second and deferred by the third; twelve swappable model backends and forty real datasets underneath.
